issues.description: Method Farm.addAnimal(Animal): the UML in problem_statement.md declares addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean, but the solution implementation defines public void addAnimal(Animal animal) (no boolean return), and the template Farm.java currently lacks an addAnimal method (contains a TODO). This mismatch between the specification (UML), the template, and the provided solution will confuse students about the expected method signature and return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Update problem_statement.md (UML and textual tasks) to declare addAnimal(Animal): void and document that it simply adds the animal to the list; then update the template to include a void addAnimal(Animal) stub matching the UML, or (B) Change the solution and template to implement public boolean addAnimal(Animal) (for example return animals.add(animal);) and update the problem statement/UML to reflect the boolean return. Ensure tests and any example code (Main.java) are updated to use the chosen signature.
